title: Migrate biome.json schema pin to the installed Biome (2.5.5 -> 2.5.10)
description:
`biome.json` line 2 pins `https://biomejs.dev/schemas/2.5.5/schema.json` while
the installed `@biomejs/biome` is 2.5.10. Biome emits a `deserialize` INFO
diagnostic on every `npm run check` / `format:check` / `lint` run:

    The configuration schema version does not match the CLI version 2.5.10
      Expected: 2.5.10
      Found:    2.5.5

Info-level diagnostics do not fail the build (Biome has no exit-on-info flag),
so this is invisible to CI, which is exactly the accumulation AGENTS.md's
"Formatting & Linting" section warns about: "keep `biome.json` migrated to the
installed Biome (`npx biome migrate --write`)".

Pre-existing on `main` as of 6015db0; observed while verifying
eshyra-o9bd.19.1.15 (PR #507) and deliberately left out of that PR to keep it
scoped to the Foundation 2 registry.

Fix: run `npx biome migrate --write` from the repo root, confirm
`npm run check` reports zero diagnostics (not just zero errors), and commit the
`biome.json` change on its own branch. Per AGENTS.md's dependency rules, keep
this separate from feature work; a semver-major Biome bump is a different
decision and is not in scope here.
close_reason: Stale: resolved by PR #530 (eshyra-ldtn, merged bc190dc), which ran npx biome migrate --write as part of landing Biome 2.5.12. Verified on main at 84e8e79: biome.json $schema is 2.5.12 and matches the installed CLI (biome --version 2.5.12); 'biome check --diagnostic-level=info .' reports zero diagnostics, so the deserialize INFO this bead tracked is gone; 'biome migrate' reports 'no migration needed', i.e. the fix this bead prescribes is now a no-op. Duplicate of eshyra-2whc, filed one day earlier for the same info diagnostic.
